indicators.title: Mapped street length
indicators.definition: Length of mapped drivable street centerlines clipped to the assessment polygon.
indicators.source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx 2.1.0; https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
indicators.geography: Confirmed county polygon, ACS 2024 TIGER boundary
indicators.updateFrequency: OSM continuously edited; fetch on demand and retain timestamp
indicators.calculation: Simplify drive graph; convert to undirected multigraph to remove reciprocal edges; project EPSG:5070; clip each geometry; sum lengths / 1000.
indicators.limitations: Divided carriageways remain separate. Excludes non-drivable paths and private roads omitted by drive filter. Does not measure condition or completeness.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Mapped intersection density
indicators.definition: Consolidated mapped street intersections per square kilometer of Census land area.
indicators.source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx 2.1.0; https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
indicators.geography: Confirmed county polygon; land area from same TIGER vintage
indicators.updateFrequency: On demand; compare only consistent snapshots/settings
indicators.calculation: Project graph to EPSG:5070; consolidate intersections with 10 m node buffers, rebuild_graph=False and dead_ends=False; count resulting centroids inside polygon / (AREALAND / 1e6).
indicators.limitations: Consolidation is geometric, not an operational intersection audit. Density has no universal readiness direction. Edge effects and land-area denominator affect comparisons.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Mean mapped segment length
indicators.definition: Mean length of simplified physical street segments intersecting the study polygon.
indicators.source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx 2.1.0; https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
indicators.calculation: Sum clipped undirected segment lengths / number of positive-length clipped segments.
indicators.limitations: Boundary-clipped segments are shorter. Graph simplification and divided roads affect interpretation; not equivalent to block length.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Sidewalk attribute coverage
indicators.definition: Length-weighted availability of sidewalk attributes on eligible mapped drivable streets.
indicators.source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx 2.1.0; https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
indicators.calculation: 100 × clipped length carrying a sidewalk, sidewalk:left, sidewalk:right or sidewalk:both tag / clipped eligible length. Exclude motorway and motorway_link. All values including no count as documented.
indicators.limitations: Measures documentation only, not sidewalk presence, continuity, accessibility or quality. Mixed tag lists require all components documented; simplified segments with ambiguous coverage are excluded from numerator.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Resident population
indicators.definition: Estimated resident population, all ages.
indicators.source: US Census ACS 2024 5-year; official API with configured key or explicitly labeled Census Reporter mirror; https://api.censusreporter.org/1.0/data/show/acs2024_5yr
indicators.calculation: Read B01003_001E and matching M; retain 90% margin of error and annotations where available.
indicators.limitations: Five-year pooled estimate, not a current-year census. Resident/household context does not establish demand, institutional capability, trust or workplace jobs.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Households
indicators.definition: Estimated households in the household vehicle-availability universe.
indicators.source: US Census ACS 2024 5-year; official API with configured key or explicitly labeled Census Reporter mirror; https://api.censusreporter.org/1.0/data/show/acs2024_5yr
indicators.calculation: Read B08201_001E and matching M; retain 90% margin of error and annotations where available.
indicators.limitations: Five-year pooled estimate, not a current-year census. Resident/household context does not establish demand, institutional capability, trust or workplace jobs.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Median household income
indicators.definition: Median household income in the past 12 months, in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars.
indicators.source: US Census ACS 2024 5-year; official API with configured key or explicitly labeled Census Reporter mirror; https://api.censusreporter.org/1.0/data/show/acs2024_5yr
indicators.calculation: Read B19013_001E and matching M; retain 90% margin of error and annotations where available.
indicators.limitations: Five-year pooled estimate, not a current-year census. Resident/household context does not establish demand, institutional capability, trust or workplace jobs.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Households without a vehicle
indicators.definition: Share of households reporting no vehicle available.
indicators.source: US Census ACS 2024 5-year; official API with configured key or explicitly labeled Census Reporter mirror; https://api.censusreporter.org/1.0/data/show/acs2024_5yr
indicators.calculation: 100 × B08201_002E / B08201_001E. MOE = 100 × sqrt(M_num² + ratio² × M_den²) / denominator, a ratio approximation without covariance; retain raw values.
indicators.limitations: Not an unmet-demand or trust measure. Approximate MOE ignores numerator-denominator covariance; no MOE when either input unavailable. Zero denominator is unknown.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Deployment authority and accountable owners
indicators.definition: Named decision rights, approvals, contracts and escalation owners.
indicators.source: Official adopted policies, permits, procurement records and responsible-agency confirmation
indicators.updateFrequency: At assessment and on policy change
indicators.calculation: Reviewer checks authority, scope, operational responsibilities and implementation evidence.
indicators.limitations: A policy document does not establish functioning coordination.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Physical asset suitability
indicators.definition: Verified condition and accessible use of assets for the proposed deployment.
indicators.source: Site inspection, asset register, accessibility audit, maintenance records
indicators.updateFrequency: At assessment and after material site change
indicators.calculation: Compare dated inspections against explicit use-case requirements.
indicators.limitations: OSM geometry alone cannot establish condition or compliance.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Operational data interoperability
indicators.definition: Tested, governed information exchange required for deployment.
indicators.source: Interface tests, agreements, security/privacy reviews and monitoring logs
indicators.updateFrequency: At assessment and material system change
indicators.calculation: Review interface tests and access, security, retention and ownership controls.
indicators.limitations: A public API or dataset alone is insufficient.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Curb rules and accessible operations
indicators.definition: Verified curb permissions, accessibility and management during operating periods.
indicators.source: Official curb rules, CDS records, site audit and enforcement responsibilities
indicators.geography: Curb segments linked to operating footprint
indicators.calculation: Join rules to locations and time; reviewer verifies accessibility, conflicts and ownership.
indicators.limitations: Static OSM tags are not authoritative curb regulations.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Confirmed energy and facility capacity
indicators.definition: Verified load capacity, access, site control and maintenance for the proposed fleet.
indicators.source: Utility study, facility confirmation, site agreements and commissioning records
indicators.updateFrequency: At assessment and material load/site change
indicators.calculation: Compare documented capacity and operating demand; verify access and contingencies.
indicators.limitations: Public charger counts do not establish spare capacity or fleet access.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Trained workforce and operational coverage
indicators.definition: Evidence of trained staff, maintained procedures and defined handoffs.
indicators.source: Competency maps, training records, staffing schedules, SOPs and labor review
indicators.calculation: Review training, shifts, operating responsibilities and transition arrangements.
indicators.limitations: Resident or regional employment figures do not establish employer capability.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Exercised incident and continuity response
indicators.definition: Deployment-specific response and recovery arrangements tested with relevant actors.
indicators.source: Hazard reviews, exercise records, responder training and incident logs
indicators.calculation: Verify scope, contacts, responder access, exercise results and corrective actions.
indicators.limitations: Published general plans are insufficient; this is not safety certification.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Operational mobility integration
indicators.definition: Documented and tested coordination with affected mobility services.
indicators.source: Partner agreements, accessible transfer audits, service-impact evaluation
indicators.calculation: Review coordinated operations, access safeguards, baselines and measures.
indicators.limitations: Transit proximity does not establish integration or mode shift.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Representative participation and accountability
indicators.definition: Evidence that affected groups can shape, access and scrutinize deployment.
indicators.source: Engagement records, representative surveys, accessible feedback, grievance tracking
indicators.calculation: Review representation, barriers, responses and disaggregated benefits/burdens.
indicators.limitations: Do not infer sentiment or acceptance from demographics.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Demand and deployment viability
indicators.definition: Credible demand, funding, lifecycle costs and accountable public-benefit commitments.
indicators.source: Customer commitments, budgets, cost models, evaluation plans
indicators.units: Documented status; currency and timeframe as supplied
indicators.geography: Deployment business case and affected population
indicators.calculation: Review assumptions, partner commitments, sensitivity and public-value measures.
indicators.limitations: Regional assets or industry concentration alone do not demonstrate viability.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Time-specific demand and capacity
indicators.definition: Observed demand relative to available processing capacity during comparable periods.
indicators.source: Time-stamped events and measured service capacity; StreetOps concepts
indicators.calculation: Observed arrivals / measured service capacity with matched units.
indicators.limitations: No inference from POI counts; unavailable without suitable operational records.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Scheduled transit availability
indicators.definition: Scheduled service near accessible deployment locations.
indicators.source: Official agency GTFS
indicators.calculation: Respect calendars, exceptions, service-day times, accessibility and parent stops.
indicators.limitations: Schedule is not reliability or verified accessible transfer.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Reported charging facilities
indicators.definition: Published charging locations and reported equipment attributes.
indicators.source: US DOE AFDC station inventory
indicators.calculation: Deduplicate stations/ports, distinguish public/private access and status.
indicators.limitations: Not spare grid capacity or guaranteed fleet compatibility.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.

indicators.title: Workplace employment context
indicators.definition: Jobs located in the assessment geography by available industry category.
indicators.source: Census LEHD LODES workplace area characteristics
indicators.geography: Native blocks aggregated to explicitly matched geography
indicators.calculation: Use workplace WAC counts with year and coverage; do not substitute resident ACS employment.
indicators.limitations: Jobs are not trained staff, vacancies or organizational commitments.
indicators.reviewRequirement: Reviewer must assess use-case relevance and geographic fit. No automatic maturity rating.
